raw_text: ☀️🌻🌱 Good morning, Oleg. It is a pleasure to assist you today, September 25, 2026, as the stars align to offer you a unique vantage point for your professional and personal endeavors. Your natal chart is anchored by an Ascendant in Aquarius (1°32'), and today’s transit of the Moon through Pisces activates your 2nd house of personal finances, while the governing energy of Venus on this Friday enhances the potential for harmonious resolutions in your business affairs. 🪐 Planetary influence today The transit of the Moon through the sensitive sign of Pisces highlights your 2nd house, bringing a fluid, intuitive approach to your financial management and material security. With Venus as the ruler of the day, your natal Ascendant in Aquarius feels a gentle softening, allowing you to blend your inherent intellectual detachment with the diplomatic grace required for successful high-stakes networking. 💼 Work, business and finance Today is an exceptional day for strategic planning and auditing your long-term investment portfolios, as the focus on your 2nd house rewards a methodical and calm approach. For critical business negotiations or signing important financial documents, I strongly advise you to utilize the most favorable time windows: 10:15 to 11:40 or 14:20 to 16:05, as these intervals align with the most constructive lunar aspects. Avoid impulsive spending or hasty commitments outside of these hours, as the influence of Pisces can sometimes blur the lines between necessity and desire. ❤️ Personal relationships and communication In your interactions, you will find that a patient and empathetic tone, characteristic of the Moon in Pisces, will open doors that were previously closed. Your ability to listen deeply will be perceived as a sign of strength by your business partners and associates, fostering a climate of trust that is invaluable for your long-term goals. 🌿 Health and tone Your vitality is linked to your emotional state today; therefore, avoid overexertion and prioritize mental clarity through brief, intentional pauses. To support your well-being, I suggest a grounding ritual this evening, such as a warm bath or a quiet walk, to release the accumulated mental tension of a productive business day. 💡 Good advice for today Because the 14th lunar day can sometimes bring an overwhelming influx of information, I advise you to practice conscious filtering: do not react immediately to every incoming request. If you feel the pressure of the day mounting, take three deep, intentional breaths and step away from your digital screens for ten minutes to regain your natural, Aquarian perspective and objective focus. ✨ Wish for today May your day be as expansive and clear as the horizon, and may you find that every challenge you encounter today serves as a stepping stone toward the prosperous future you are so diligently building. Trust in your inner wisdom, Oleg, for you have all the tools necessary to turn this day into a masterpiece of strategic success.
